ns2:section.sectionText: Students who have completed ADV 493 should not register for ADV 393. While the number is different, the course content is the same. Registering for the new course would be seen as duplicate credit. Duplicate credit does not count toward graduation and students registering for the duplicate course will be asked to drop. Please note: Additional seats may be available to ADV/AGCM sophomores beginning November 15 at 11:00 am. Registration is opened to the campus on November 19 at 11:00 am.
